rows.text: c Freight Rats
Rats that have mutated due to the bio waste pumped through the sewage systems. Typically 3’ in size.
c Smuggler Bats
Often deliberately placed in cargo holds to discourage docking inspections. Typically 4’ in size.
 Boom Spider
An aggressive stowaway. They are usually eradicated before reaching adulthood. Typically 4’ in size.
t Crazed Crew
Traumatised by their surroundings, they have become disturbed and will attack anyone on sight.
 Plasma Moths
They have acclimatised to the low levels of life support used in cargo holds. Typically 4’ in size.
c Giant Conduit Snake
Feeding on Freight Rats, they have mutated and evolved an acidic venom. Typically 10’ long.
 Freight Mosquitoes
They will attack and infect anything that has a pulse. Typically ½’ in size, each.
s Malfunctioning Droid
The android’s software is malfunctioning and it is unable to switch off its seek and destroy protocols.
t Crazed Security
Time in space can be difficult and often prolonged voyages/deployments leads to psychological issues. Typically 6’ in size.
t Corporate Troopers
Often sent to facilities by corporations to remove and cover-up all traces of illegal activities.
 Freight Roach
Living on biowaste, they will often attack anything that passes by. Typically 3’ in size.
t Mutated Crew
Often prolonged exposure to environmental conditions has led to physical mutations amongst crews. They cannot be trusted!

≡ Metamorph
